name: bt_get_pairing_state

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64; IDA shape review of the exact-state accessor and stock bond create/remove callers

notes: Exact 3.101.043 IDA recovery: 0x0C3B60A0/0x0C3B60A1 returns record + 0xAC, matching the 3.101.036 exact-state accessor and the state read used by bt_create_bond_private/bt_remove_bond_private. The previous 0x0C3B5F78 candidate returns record[0xAB] > 3 and is not the transport-specific pairing-state byte. Device behavior remains unprobed.
